newsitem.title: USA: Citicorp says not target of criminal probe.
newsitem.headline: Citicorp says not target of criminal probe.

text.p: Citicorp said it continues to cooperate with a U.S. Justice Department probe of accounts handled on behalf of Raul Salinas de Gortari, brother of former Mexican President Carlos Salinas de Gortari, but reiterated it is not itself the target of a criminal probe.
"We are cooperating fully with authorities investigating the matter," said Citicorp spokesman Richard Howe.
"We have been assured by the U.S. Justice Department that neither the company nor any employee is a target of any criminal investigation," he added.

Howe's comment reiterated statements issued by Citicorp repeatedly over the course of the Justice Department's investigation. He made the statement in response to an article in Monday's Wall Street Journal, which cited unidentified sources at Citibank as saying the probe appeared aimed at producing an indictment against the bank.
Howe declined to comment further on the Journal article or the investigation, citing legal restrictions against doing so.
